about_short_description.short_description: Moneyview is a provider of a credit platform that offers loans and financial management tools.

product.name: Personal Loan
product.description: Unsecured loans from ₹5,000 to ₹10 lakh with flexible repayment terms, disbursed digitally within 24 hours of approval.

product.name: Home Loan
product.description: Loans for purchasing or constructing homes with interest rates starting from 8.50% per annum.

product.name: Loan on Property
product.description: Loans up to ₹75 lakh against property collateral without requiring income tax returns.

product.name: Business Loan
product.description: Unsecured loans up to ₹5 lakh with repayment tenures up to 60 months for business purposes.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Credit cards issued by partner banks such as HDFC and AU Bank, accessible through the Moneyview platform.

product.name: Fixed Deposit Investment (FD Select)
product.description: Digital platform to invest in fixed deposits from RBI-regulated banks and NBFCs starting at ₹1,000 with guaranteed interest rates.
